history_query: previous user text + newline + previous agent text + newline + current user text; first round current only; no role labels
history_scope: exact official existing speaker/text only; no generated history or annotations
query_instruction: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:
passage_input: title + space + exact original text, same as BM25 fields; no query instruction
pooling: CLS final hidden state; L2 normalize; float32 weights and embeddings
truncation: official model token limit, right truncation; no corpus edit or extra chunks; full passages still returned
dense_ranking: dot product between L2 normalized embeddings, score descending; full passage_id ascending tie

embedding_execution.sequence_order: sort by token length then passage_id to reduce batch padding; one committed embedding per passage
embedding_execution.cache: independent float32 numpy mmap, batch journal and checkpoint; reuse completed rows only

eval_population: same 105 DEV with qrels; other 11 unavailable
